basic.rule: On dev: maximize Evidence Hit@3, then Hit@1, then context evidence rate, then prefer alpha 0.5, then smaller alpha. Select agent context budget using dev grounded answer grades and latency. Never use test for tuning.
basic.agent_validation: Dev review: baseline, hybrid 2400, hybrid 4800 all answer 15/15 correctly; choose 2400 for lower token use and fewer redundant citations. Raw retrieval selects alpha .5.

bonus.rule: On dev: maximize Evidence Hit@3, then Hit@1, then context evidence rate, then prefer alpha 0.5, then smaller alpha. Select agent context budget using dev grounded answer grades and latency. Never use test for tuning.
bonus.agent_validation: vision-v2 dev original-source review: 15 answerable correct with supporting citations; 3 missing-evidence questions correctly decline to provide unsupported requested data. Report answers require original-page vision. alpha .5 and per-search budget 4800 selected on dev.
